description: This Kotlin source file defines the DeviceIdentity data class and the DeviceIdentityStore class, which manages device identity creation, storage, signing, and verification using cryptographic operations and file I/O.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: Data class representing a device's identity, including device ID, public key, private key, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityStore
classes.description: Class responsible for managing device identity lifecycle, including creation, storage, signing payloads, and signature verification.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads existing device identity or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string using the device's private key.

methods.name: verifySelfSignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature against the payload using the device's public key.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the device's public key in URL-safe Base64 encoding.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the device identity from storage.

methods.name: readIdentity
methods.description: Reads and deserializes the device identity from a file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and saves the device identity to storage.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity with cryptographic keys and device ID.

methods.name: deriveDeviceId
methods.description: Derives device ID from public key.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of data and returns as hex string.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes byte array into URL-safe Base64 string.

methods.name: base64UrlDecode
methods.description: Decodes URL-safe Base64 string into byte array.
